unregistered-contract: payload_contract not in the memory-kind registry
dotted-contract-version: durable-record token pattern forbids minor versions
payload-shape-mismatch: payload must validate against its kind schema
blob-unknown-classification: blob classification is required at write; unknown is not a value
agent-writes-maintainer-kind: identity is maintainer-class; an agent claim fails closed
secret-shaped-member: no secret-shaped member names in any payload
nested-secret-shaped-member: secret-shaped names rejected at any depth
blob-over-cap: blob body exceeds the registry cap
handoff-open-with-ack-time: open handoff must not carry acknowledged_at
